notes: POC focused on Dedicated capacity for low-latency control assistant on factory floors. Customer requires deterministic throughput and reserved GPU planning rather than pay-as-you-go. Quote: "we cannot tolerate >200ms p95 for 256-token responses during shift-critical operations". Workload mix: 60% streaming chat (single- and multi-turn operator queries), 25% embeddings for vector search across SOPs and sensor logs, 15% reranking of candidate operator action suggestions. Prefers quantized model variants if safety filters preserved. Security must support SAML SSO, KMS-managed keys, audit logs; initial ask: 7-year audit log retention (subject to negotiation). Data residency: US-East + Canada for subset of logs. Test plan: 2-week soak then 48h high-concurrency ramp. Acceptance criteria: sustained throughput for 72h at target QPS with <=1% error rate; p95 <=200ms for 256-token gen under normal load and <=300ms under burst; model quality within 5% of baseline NDCG for rerank; successful KMS rotation and SIEM ingestion of audit logs.
reserved_gpu_commitment: 6 x H100-80GB equivalent committed; burst to 8 during peak windows; option to scale to 10 if throughput exceeds targets
